qualifier: AMPA and kainate as well as NMDA receptor activation
name: AMPA, NMDA and kainate receptor excitatory signalling
rationale: All members concern ionotropic glutamate receptor activation, trafficking and glutamatergic synaptic responses; unlike the NMDA-CREB and long-term plasticity confusables, the theme covers AMPA and kainate receptor activation and fast excitatory transmission.

qualifier: Notch and TSR O-fucose/O-glucose plus heparan sulfate
name: Notch and TSR O-glycosylation with heparan sulfate synthesis
rationale: Members are O-linked glycosylation of proteins, namely O-fucose/O-glucose modification of Notch and TSR domains and EXT-driven heparan sulfate chain synthesis; the chondroitin/keratan, N-glycan and somitogenesis confusables lack either the Notch O-glycosylation or the heparan sulfate arm.

qualifier: PD-L1 turnover and antitumor T cell response
name: Proteasome function and PD-L1 turnover in antitumor immunity
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent proteolysis with PD-L1 glycosylation and degradation and CD8 T cell antitumor responses; the PD-L1 and antitumor members are absent from the MHC class I loading and Nef/Vpu degradation confusables.

core: Enteric neural development and visceral smooth muscle motility
name: Enteric neural crest RET/endothelin signalling and visceral motility
rationale: Members span GDNF-RET and endothelin receptor signalling in neural crest-derived enteric nervous system development and the resulting gut and urinary smooth muscle motility; confusables lack RET/GDNF signalling and either the enteric development or the gut motility arm.

qualifier: excision, break and translesion repair plus telomere maintenance
name: Excision, break and translesion DNA repair with telomere maintenance
rationale: The 176 members cover essentially every DNA repair route (BER, NER, MMR, HR, NHEJ, TLS, crosslink and alkylation repair) together with telomere maintenance and replication-linked damage responses; closest confusables are narrower (double-strand break, replication initiation, chromatin assembly) and lack the excision repair and telomere members.

name: VEGF and TGF-beta2 production driving sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: All members promote endothelial sprouting angiogenesis through growth factor production and VEGF receptor signalling; unlike the angiogenesis, Tie2 and endothelial proliferation confusables, the theme centres on inducing VEGF and TGF-beta2 production.

qualifier: laminin-integrin interactions and anchoring fibril collagen
name: Basement membrane laminin-integrin interactions and anchoring fibrils
rationale: Members concern basement membrane assembly through laminin and integrin interactions, collagen trimerization and anchoring fibrils; confusables emphasise fibrillar collagen crosslinking, elastic fibres, fibronectin or VWF-collagen binding instead of laminin.

name: Aggresome formation and selective autophagy of misfolded proteins
rationale: Members cover responses to misfolded proteins via aggresome assembly, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy, with ataxin-3 DUBs and oligomer stability; confusables emphasise ERAD, folding chaperones or stress granules rather than aggresome and autophagic clearance.

qualifier: of myeloid, BCR and interleukin genes
name: RUNX-family transcriptional control of myeloid and lymphoid genes
rationale: Every member is RUNX1/2/3-driven transcription of haematopoietic target genes (myeloid differentiation, BCR and interleukin signalling); granulopoiesis and myeloid differentiation confusables share none of these RUNX target programmes.

name: Misfolded protein quality control by ERAD and selective autophagy
rationale: Members cover handling of misfolded proteins by unfolding, ERAD regulation, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, chaperone-mediated and microautophagy; confusables lack the ERAD and ER-phagy arm or focus on ribosome quality control and stress granules.

qualifier: oncogenic RAS/RAF mutants and integrin linkage
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF mutants and integrins
rationale: All members describe RAF to MAP2K/MAPK activation, by BRAF/RAF1 mutants, fusions and RAS mutants or by integrin-coupled GRB2:SOS and p130Cas; the integrin linkage distinguishes it from MAPK feedback and MRAS/SHOC2 confusables, and the oncogenic RAF members from the Rap1 confusable.

name: Hemidesmosome and basement membrane integrin-laminin adhesion
rationale: Members concern epithelial anchoring to the basement membrane through integrin-laminin interactions, anchoring fibril collagen and hemidesmosome assembly; hemidesmosomes and integrin surface interactions are what the desmosome, dystroglycan and collagen-crosslinking confusables lack.

name: Proteasome-dependent MHC class I antigen processing and loading
rationale: Members link proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-independent degradation to MHC class I peptide loading, endogenous and cross-presentation; confusables either lack the MHC class I loading members (PD-L1, Nef/Vpu) or lack the proteasome members (broad antigen presentation).

qualifier: nephron tubule patterning and nephric duct formation
name: Nephron tubule patterning and nephric duct development
rationale: All members are steps in kidney organogenesis, from intermediate mesoderm and nephric duct to renal vesicle, S-shaped body and nephron segment differentiation; confusables centre on ureteric bud formation and branching or kidney growth control and lack the nephron segmentation members.

qualifier: bone and dentin, with matrix protein phosphorylation
name: Regulation of bone and dentin mineralization
rationale: Members regulate mineralization of bone and dentin, including secreted matrix protein phosphorylation and chondrocyte maturation; confusables add FGF23/Klotho phosphate signalling, osteoclast resorption or enamel and lack dentinogenesis and protein phosphorylation.

name: Endosomal toll-like receptor trafficking and TLR7/8/9 signalling
rationale: Members are endosomal nucleic acid-sensing TLRs (TLR3/7/8/9), their UNC93B1-dependent trafficking and IRF5 activation; confusables are downstream type I interferon production and antiviral programmes lacking TLR trafficking and regulation.

name: Non-vesicular lipid transfer and Rab geranylgeranylation
rationale: Members combine protein-mediated transfer of glycolipids, ceramide-1-phosphate and phospholipids between membranes with Rab prenylation and GEF activation; flippase, vesicular traffic and phospholipid catabolism confusables lack the Rab prenylation or glycolipid transfer members.

name: Photoreceptor outer segment development and maintenance
rationale: Members concern photoreceptor morphogenesis, cone development, outer segment organization and protein targeting, and long-term photoreceptor maintenance; confusables are ciliary transport or retinal neuron differentiation and lack outer segment and maintenance members.

qualifier: optic cup-derived retina, iris and pigmentation
name: Embryonic optic cup, retina and iris morphogenesis
rationale: All members describe embryonic morphogenesis of optic cup derivatives (retina, iris, pigmented epithelium); confusables cover lens and cornea or ear and craniofacial development.

name: mRNA poly(A) tail synthesis, shortening and decay
rationale: Members cover 3'-end cleavage and polyadenylation, poly(A) tail shortening, decapping and 5'-3' decay; ARE-binding protein and miRNA confusables lack polyadenylation, while the histone 3'-end confusable lacks deadenylation and decay.

name: Osteoblast and mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members regulate osteoblast proliferation and differentiation in both directions plus mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation (with Wnt signalling); the mesenchymal stem cell members distinguish it from bone formation and mineralization confusables.

qualifier: branched-chain amino acid catabolism and CoA, lipoate, biotin cofactors
name: Mitochondrial 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and branched-chain acyl-CoA catabolism
rationale: Members centre on PDH, OGDH, BCKDH and OADH complexes, their lipoate, biotin and CoA cofactors, and branched-chain amino acid and lysine catabolism with its inborn errors; confusables emphasise fatty acid beta-oxidation, TCA iron-sulfur and isocitrate/malate steps or vitamin B6.

name: Mevalonate isoprenoid and cholesterol biosynthesis
rationale: All members are steps from isopentenyl diphosphate through farnesyl/geranylgeranyl diphosphate and lanosterol to cholesterol; confusables cover fatty acid elongation and peroxisomal or cytochrome P450 disorders.

name: MYC-driven RNA polymerase I/III transcription and ribosome biogenesis
rationale: Members cover rRNA and tRNA transcription by RNA polymerases I and III, rRNA processing and ribosome export, under MYC targets and nucleolar chromatin control; confusables are splicing, RNA decay and translation initiation, lacking the Pol I/III transcription and MYC members.

core: Kinase control of hepatic metabolic regulators
name: Glucagon-PKA and AMPK phosphorylation of metabolic regulators
rationale: All three members describe inhibitory phosphorylation of key metabolic factors such as ChREBP by glucagon-activated PKA and by AMPK; confusables cover ChREBP activation by glucose, insulin secretion or glycogen metabolism.
